source.title: WQAC Leader Announcement (December 2023)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Deni Mintsaev will become the new Leader of the WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC). Deni was already working as a Senior Member in the committee.
<!-- break -->
Deni was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Daniel Vædele Egdal for the work he has done for the WQAC and extend our support and best wishes to Deni as he takes on his new responsibilities.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

* Arash Zuhayr Udoy

We thank Arash for applying and both applications can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/155TTaYwao8RuE0FEs4rsHl5TsRbn78Pm).

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会负责人任命公告（2023 年 12 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Deni Mintsaev 将担任 WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）的新任负责人。Deni 此前已在委员会担任高级成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Deni，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Daniel Vædele Egdal 为 WQAC 所做的工作。我们也支持 Deni 承担新的职责，祝他工作顺利。

董事会还收到了以下申请人的材料：

* Arash Zuhayr Udoy

感谢 Arash 提交申请。两人的申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/155TTaYwao8RuE0FEs4rsHl5TsRbn78Pm)查看。
